jobs.title: Senior Cards Portfolio Manager
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

We're looking for an experienced Portfolio Growth Manager to own the growth and health of Tabby's card program end\-to\-end.  


  

This role sits at the intersection of scheme relationships, compliance and commercial strategy working closely with Card Scheme, Compliance, Risk and Product to grow card issuance, activation and usage while keeping the program fully aligned with scheme rules and regulatory requirements.  


  

You'll lead portfolio growth initiatives, manage scheme relationships and reporting, and own the compliance obligations tied to the card program — from scheme mandates to regulatory requirements. You're comfortable balancing a commercial growth agenda with the discipline compliance demands.  


  

If you enjoy growing a card program commercially while also being the person who keeps it compliant and audit\-ready, this role is for you.  

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Own portfolio growth strategy for Tabby's card program including driving growth across the funnel and identify and execute growth levers pricing, incentives and partnerships.
* Manage day\-to\-day relationships with card schemes, including program reporting, mandates, incentives and new scheme initiatives.
* Ensure the card program's ongoing compliance with scheme rules, regulatory requirements and internal risk policies.
* Partner with Compliance, Risk and Legal to manage scheme audits, certifications and regulatory filings related to the card program.
* Track and report portfolio performance (activation, spend, retention) and compliance status to internal and external stakeholders.
* Stay ahead of scheme rule changes and regulatory updates, translating them into action plans across the business.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering to prioritize features that support both growth and compliance goals.

  


### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

  

* 3–4 years of experience in banking or fintech, with direct exposure to card programs, scheme management or compliance.
* Working knowledge of card scheme rule and the regulatory requirements governing card programs.
* Strong analytical skills, comfortable working with portfolio performance data to drive growth decisions.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills to work across Compliance, Risk, Marketing, Product \& Tech and external scheme partners.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English \& Arabic a must

  


### **Benefits**

  

* We have an inclusive company culture, embracing diversity, integrity and transparency. We strive for work\-life balance and cherish the moments you spend with your loved ones, off\-work. In the same spirit as for our product, we are caring and nurturing for our employees.
* Our people are granted 100% trust and freedom to apply their own vision and come up with their ideas from day 1 at Tabby. You are the one who takes responsibility for your area of work. We encourage everyone to think and make decisions like Tabby was their own business, well because it is. Our employee stock options programme is available for everyone.
* You will have an opportunity to learn and grow in one of the fastest growing fintech companies in the region
* We offer you relocation support as well as we guide you through all the process.
* We’ll set you up with the devices required for your work.

### **About Tabby**


Tabby creates financial freedom in the way people shop, earn and save, by reshaping their relationship with money.  

  

The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in\-store with no interest or fees. Over 32,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA and Shein use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores.  

  

Tabby has generated over $7 billion in transaction volume for its partner brands and has the highest rated, most reviewed, largest and fastest growing app of any fintech in the GCC region.  

  

Tabby launched operations in 2020 and has raised \+$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors.

jobs.title: UAE N National_ Sr Financial Analyst - Pricing & RV_ Al Futtaim Financial Services
jobs.description:
**Job Requisition ID:** 181278



About Al\-Futtaim  

Established in the 1930s, Al\-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al\-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks \& Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al\-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long\-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

  


**Overview of the role :**

  



The Senior Financial Analyst – Pricing \& Residual Value will support the Senior Finance Manager in driving pricing governance, residual value management, portfolio profitability analysis, and commercial decision support across the Financial Services Division. The role will be responsible for developing pricing models, monitoring asset performance, validating residual value assumptions, and providing analytical insights to optimize profitability, competitiveness, and risk\-adjusted returns across financial products and portfolios

  


**What you will do :**

  


**Pricing Strategy \& Profitability Analysis**

  



1\. Develop, maintain, and enhance pricing models for Financial Services products, ensuring alignment with profitability, risk, and growth objectives.  

2\. Conduct detailed profitability analysis by product, customer segment, channel, and portfolio to identify value creation opportunities.  

3\. Provide pricing recommendations and business cases to support strategic initiatives, market expansion, and product launches.  

4\. Monitor actual portfolio performance against pricing assumptions and recommend corrective actions where required.  

5\. Evaluate the financial impact of market changes, competitor pricing, cost fluctuations, and economic conditions on product profitability.  

6\. Partner with Commercial, Sales, Risk, and Finance teams to ensure pricing decisions balance competitiveness and sustainable returns.

  


**Residual Value Management**

  



1\. Develop and maintain residual value methodologies, assumptions, and forecasting models across applicable asset classes.  

2\. Monitor residual value performance against actual market outcomes and identify emerging trends or risks.



3\. Prepare residual value risk assessments and recommend actions to mitigate exposure.

  


**Portfolio Analytics \& Performance Management**

  



1\. Develop portfolio performance dashboards and analytical reports for management decision\-making.  

2\. Monitor portfolio trends, yield performance, asset utilization, and return metrics.  

3\. Analyze key performance drivers impacting portfolio profitability and operational efficiency.

  


**Governance, Policies \& Controls**

  



1\. Support the development and maintenance of pricing and residual value policies, methodologies, and governance frameworks.  

2\. Ensure compliance with internal approval authorities, financial controls, and risk management guidelines.

  


**Business Transformation \& Data Analytics**

  



1\. Develop automated pricing and profitability dashboards using advanced analytics tools.  

2\. Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance pricing effectiveness and reporting efficiency.  

3\. Support digital transformation initiatives through data modelling, process automation, and analytical innovation

  


**Required Skills to be successful**

  


* 2–5 years’ experience in corporate finance, treasury, banking or financial services
* Understanding of financial markets, forex and Pricing , accounting including FX, liquidity, cashflow and various financial instruments


* Strong analytical and financial modelling skills

  


**What Equips for you for the role :**

  


* Qualified in Finance and/or Accounting
* Professional qualification (MBA / ACCA / CA / CIMA / CFA – part or fully qualified preferred)

  

We’re here to provide excellent service but a little help from you can ensure a five\-star candidate experience from start to finish.

  



Before you click “apply”: Please read the job description carefully to ensure you can confidently demonstrate **why** this opportunity is right for you and take the time to put together a well\-crafted and personalised CV to further boost your visibility. Our global Talent Acquisition team members are all assigned to specific businesses to ensure that we make the best matches between talent and opportunities. We not only consider the requisite compatibility of skills and behaviours, but also how candidates align with our Values of Respect, Integrity, Collaboration, and Excellence.

  



As part of our candidate experience promise, we also want to make ourselves available to you throughout the application process. We make every effort to review and respond to every application.
